summary: Comprehensive frontend regression + new-feature verification of the Chahal Ayurvedic redesign. All existing testids, backend integration (POST /api/appointments returns 200), navbar hide-on-scroll, testimonials embla carousel (prev/next/dots + auto-advance ~5s), appointment form (floating labels + calendar popover + submit), sticky mobile CTA, language toggle + cac-lang localStorage persistence, 12 treatment cards with new treatment-cta-<id> hover CTAs, and hero floating leaf/sprout SVG motifs all VERIFIED PASSING. One minor UX gap: newsletter 'invalid email' path never shows the custom toast because native HTML5 validation of type="email" intercepts submit before onSubmit runs.
passed: Homepage loads on public URL; navbar renders; console clean
Hero CTAs present: hero-book-btn, hero-call-btn, hero-whatsapp-btn
Hero has 6 floating lucide Leaf/Sprout SVG icons in DOM (parallax translate on scroll)
All navbar testids present: nav-link-home/about/treatments/gallery/contact, nav-book-appointment-btn, nav-mobile-toggle
Sticky navbar hides (adds -translate-y-full) when scrolling DOWN past 120px
Sticky navbar reappears (translate-y-0) when scrolling UP (verified with real mouse-wheel events; programmatic scrollTo can be flaky)
Testimonials embla carousel: 4 dots, prev/next both advance selected snap; testimonial-dot-2 click navigates to index 2
Testimonials auto-advance ~every 5s (index changed 2 -> 3 after ~5.8s wait with mouse moved away)

Appointment form: floating labels rendered; Select opens 13 options; calendar popover shows 25+ enabled days; POST /api/appointments returned 200 and sonner toast 'Appointment request received.' shown
Footer newsletter VALID email path: 'Thanks! You're subscribed for wellness tips.' toast fires (UI-only, no backend call as expected)
Sticky mobile CTA (sticky-mobile-cta, mobile-cta-call/whatsapp/book) hidden on desktop 1920px, visible on 390px mobile viewport
Language toggle: EN <-> PA updates UI; localStorage key 'cac-lang' set correctly; persists across reload
Treatments page renders exactly 12 treatment-card-<id> and 12 matching treatment-cta-<id> Consult links (including pcod, hair-fall, infertility)
failed: Newsletter INVALID email path: custom sonner error toast never fires because <input type="email"> triggers native HTML5 validation bubble ('Please include an @...') that blocks the form submit event, so the toast.error() branch in Footer.jsx is unreachable

ui_bugs.issue: Native HTML5 email validation intercepts submit; requested 'invalid email shows error toast' behavior is unreachable

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/components/site/Footer.jsx, either (a) change input type to 'text' with inputMode="email", or (b) add noValidate on the <form>, or (c) keep native validation but drop the toast.error branch since it's dead code. Recommended: add noValidate on the form so JS validation + toast can run.
critical_code_review_comments: Newsletter form dead-code branch: toast.error path is unreachable due to HTML5 type=email native validation blocking submit. Either remove or bypass with noValidate.

Hero parallax attaches a scroll listener that setState's every scroll event (setY). This causes re-renders on every scroll tick; consider throttling with requestAnimationFrame to reduce jank on low-end devices.
TestimonialsSection auto-advance interval is cleared/restarted on every paused change, which is fine, but there's no cleanup guard if user rapidly hovers in/out — non-critical.
Sticky mobile CTA overlaps floating-whatsapp-btn at bottom-right on small viewports (both fixed) — verify no visual overlap during real usage.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_ appointment rows created via POST /api/appointments during form submit tests (name: 'TEST User Auto', 'TEST User Auto2', phone 9876543210/9876543211).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All redesign features verified on public URL. If retesting navbar hide-on-scroll, use real mouse.wheel() events (not window.scrollTo) — the scroll handler compares against lastY.current ref and rapid programmatic scrollTo can coalesce events. Testimonials auto-advance needs the mouse to be moved away from the carousel section (pause-on-hover is active).
notes: Backend explicitly deferred per request ('frontend only'); however integration path POST /api/appointments was exercised through the form and confirmed returning 200.
